capabilities: Style Chinese, Korean, and Japanese text with span markers
Add pinyin, romanization, romaji, and furigana ruby annotations
Wrap CJK text using fenced code blocks instead of spans
Toggle pronunciations separately in Live Preview and Reading View
Insert or remove markers via hotkey commands
disambiguation: Not a font-size or text-scaling plugin; it styles CJK text and adds ruby pronunciation annotations.
extras: All pronunciation lookup is local (an IPADIC dictionary ships in a separate folder); the README warns to keep the japanese-dictionary/ folder when copying or syncing the plugin. Cantonese support is planned but not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display Chinese, Korean, or Japanese characters with pronunciation annotations above the text.
summary: CJK text styling plugin that renders Chinese, Korean, and Japanese text with optional ruby pronunciation annotations (pinyin, romanization, romaji, furigana).
